ad_intro:
Lodha (lodhagroup.com) is a Real Estate brand running ~45 active Meta creatives in India with estimated spend Rs.60-90L/mo and ads pointing to lead-form capture (sales team follows up). Macrotech Developers - India's largest residential developer by sales.

The funnel leaks at three points: (1) Creative: project static, lifestyle video gap - The gap: site-tour / drone-walkthrough video. (2) Landing page: a lead form with no 3D walkthrough or site-tour video. (3) Tracking: Pixel/GTM not verifiable on first paint; retargeting appears one-size-fits-all rather than segment-specific..

These are fixable in 7 days; we estimate ~30-40% of ad spend is wasted. Mid-market/SMB lead - high closability with a fast test budget.
ad_intelligence: Meta (Facebook + Instagram) primary; Google Search + YouTube secondary; app-install where relevant.
Several evergreen creatives running 30+ days - winners, but fatigue risk and a thin refresh cadence.
Category-siloed with limited concept testing; light UGC injection.
findings: Creative leak: Project static, lifestyle video gap. The gap: site-tour / drone-walkthrough video.
Copy leak: Current angle is static catalog-led. Missing angle: locality + lifestyle story over brochure specs.
Landing page leak: A lead form with no 3D walkthrough or site-tour video.
Tracking leak: Pixel/GTM not verifiable on first paint; retargeting appears one-size-fits-all rather than segment-specific.
wins: WIN 1 - Creative: Deploy site-tour / drone-walkthrough video
Shoot 15 fifteen-second site-tour / drone-walkthrough video and replace 30% of the weakest creatives. Expected: CTR +30-50%, CPA -15-25% within 10 days.
WIN 2 - CRO: Fix the landing experience
Add drone/site-tour video + locality lifestyle content above the lead form. Expected: CVR +30-40%.
WIN 3 - Tracking: Server-Side CAPI + Segment Retargeting

Fire Meta Pixel + CAPI server-side on key conversion events; build 3 retargeting audiences (visited but didn't convert / started checkout / dropped off) with segment-specific creatives. Expected: recapture 10-15% of dropped conversions; cleaner attribution.
